artifact.title: Checkout outage: retrospective and closure review

nodes.title: Executive summary
nodes.text: Checkout was unavailable for 47 minutes after a service credential expired. The warning fired seven days earlier but was routed to an unowned channel, leaving the team without an actionable signal.

nodes.title: Customer impact
nodes.text: 1,842 checkout attempts failed during the incident window.

nodes.title: Time to recovery
nodes.text: Service recovered 47 minutes after the first failed request.

nodes.title: Incident timeline
nodes.text: The sequence distinguishes the first technical failure from detection and recovery.

items.label: 09:04 · Error rate rises
items.detail: Checkout failures cross the customer-impact threshold.

items.label: 09:19 · Support escalates
items.detail: Customer reports reach the incident commander.

items.label: 09:47 · Service restored
items.detail: Credential rotation completes and checkout succeeds.

nodes.title: Causal chain
nodes.text: The outage required both a technical trigger and a monitoring ownership failure.

rows: Failures began within one minute of credential expiry
Seven-day warning delivered to an unowned channel
Credential rotation required undocumented manual steps

nodes.title: Residual operational risk
nodes.text: A replacement credential can still expire without ownership, testing, and escalation controls.

data.mitigation: Assign service ownership, alert on multiple channels, automate rotation, add synthetic checkout monitoring, and rehearse recovery quarterly.

nodes.title: Corrective actions
nodes.text: Closure requires preventive, detective, and recovery controls—not only a new credential.

items: Assign a named owner and backup for payment credentials
Automate rotation with a 14-day validation window
Route expiry warnings to the owned on-call service
Verify all controls with failure-injection testing

nodes.title: Closure recommendation
nodes.text: Keep the incident open until alert ownership, synthetic monitoring, and automated rotation are verified in production-like testing. Documentation alone does not sufficiently reduce recurrence risk.

nodes.title: Incident closure decision
nodes.text: Choose the current disposition after reviewing evidence and corrective actions.
